attachments_select_buyer.name: attachments_select_buyer
attachments_select_buyer.using:
"attachments"."kind" <> 'supplier_invoice' and exists (
        select 1 from "companies" c where c.id = (select public.current_company_id()) and c.type = 'buyer'
      ) and (
        "attachments"."request_id" in (select id from "requests") or
        "attachments"."order_id" in (select id from "orders") or
        "attachments"."thread_id" in (select id from "threads" where kind = 'buyer') or
        "attachments"."message_id" in (select m.id from "messages" m join "threads" th on th.id = m.thread_id where th.kind = 'buyer')
      )

attachments_select_supplier.name: attachments_select_supplier
attachments_select_supplier.using:
(
        "attachments"."thread_id" in (select id from "threads" where kind = 'supplier' and supplier_company_id = (select public.current_company_id())) or
        "attachments"."message_id" in (select m.id from "messages" m join "threads" th on th.id = m.thread_id where th.kind = 'supplier' and th.supplier_company_id = (select public.current_company_id())) or
        ("attachments"."order_id" is not null and public.supplier_can_access_order("attachments"."order_id"))
      )

attachments_insert_buyer.name: attachments_insert_buyer
attachments_insert_buyer.withCheck:
"attachments"."uploaded_by" = (select auth.uid()) and exists (
        select 1 from "companies" c where c.id = (select public.current_company_id()) and c.type = 'buyer'
      ) and (
        "attachments"."request_id" in (select id from "requests") or
        "attachments"."order_id" in (select id from "orders") or
        "attachments"."thread_id" in (select id from "threads" where kind = 'buyer') or
        "attachments"."message_id" in (select m.id from "messages" m join "threads" th on th.id = m.thread_id where th.kind = 'buyer')
      )

attachments_insert_supplier.name: attachments_insert_supplier
attachments_insert_supplier.withCheck:
"attachments"."uploaded_by" = (select auth.uid()) and (select public.current_role()) in ('owner', 'manager') and (
        "attachments"."thread_id" in (select id from "threads" where kind = 'supplier' and supplier_company_id = (select public.current_company_id())) or
        "attachments"."message_id" in (select m.id from "messages" m join "threads" th on th.id = m.thread_id where th.kind = 'supplier' and th.supplier_company_id = (select public.current_company_id())) or
        ("attachments"."order_id" is not null and public.supplier_can_access_order("attachments"."order_id"))
      )

change_requests_select_via_order.name: change_requests_select_via_order
change_requests_select_via_order.using:
"change_requests"."order_id" in (
        select o.id from "orders" o join "requests" r on r.id = o.request_id
        where r.buyer_company_id = (select public.current_company_id())
      ) or (select public.current_role()) in ('concierge', 'admin')

change_requests_insert_buyer.name: change_requests_insert_buyer
change_requests_insert_buyer.withCheck:
"change_requests"."initiator_user_id" = (select auth.uid()) and "change_requests"."order_id" in (
        select o.id from "orders" o join "requests" r on r.id = o.request_id
        where r.buyer_company_id = (select public.current_company_id())
      )

messages_insert_via_thread.name: messages_insert_via_thread
messages_insert_via_thread.withCheck: "messages"."thread_id" in (select id from "threads") and "messages"."author_user_id" = (select id from "users" where id = (select auth.uid()))

threads_select_buyer.name: threads_select_buyer

threads_insert_buyer_own.name: threads_insert_buyer_own

permissions_insert_owner.name: permissions_insert_owner

permissions_update_owner.name: permissions_update_owner
permissions_update_owner.using: (select public.current_role()) = 'owner' and "permissions"."user_id" in (select id from "users" where company_id = (select public.current_company_id()))

time_entries_update_own_active.name: time_entries_update_own_active
time_entries_update_own_active.withCheck: (select public.current_role()) in ('concierge', 'admin') and "time_entries"."user_id" = auth.uid() and "time_entries"."source" = 'active' and "time_entries"."seconds" >= 0

documents_select_via_order.name: documents_select_via_order
documents_select_via_order.using: "documents"."order_id" in (select id from "orders") and ("documents"."type" <> 'supplier_invoice' or (select public.current_role()) in ('concierge', 'admin'))

documents_insert_via_order.name: documents_insert_via_order
documents_insert_via_order.withCheck:
"documents"."order_id" in (
        select o.id from "orders" o
        join "requests" r on r.id = o.request_id
        where (select public.current_role()) in ('concierge', 'admin') or r.buyer_company_id = (select public.current_company_id())
      )

estimates_select_via_request.name: estimates_select_via_request

order_supplier_deliveries_insert_own_sup.name: order_supplier_deliveries_insert_own_supplier
order_supplier_deliveries_insert_own_sup.withCheck:
"order_supplier_deliveries"."supplier_company_id" = (select public.current_company_id())
        and "order_supplier_deliveries"."confirmed_by" = (select auth.uid())
        and (select public.current_role()) in ('owner', 'manager')
        and exists (
          select 1 from "companies" c where c.id = "order_supplier_deliveries"."supplier_company_id" and c.type = 'supplier'
        )
        and exists (
          select 1 from "orders" o
          join "plan_lines" pl on pl.plan_id = o.approved_plan_id
          where o.id = "order_supplier_deliveries"."order_id"
            and o.state = 'shipped'
            and pl.supplier_company_id = "order_supplier_deliveries"."supplier_company_id"
            and public.supplier_can_access_order("order_supplier_deliveries"."order_id")
        )

orders_update_supplier_delivery.name: orders_update_supplier_delivery
orders_update_supplier_delivery.using:
"orders"."state" = 'shipped' and public.supplier_can_access_order("orders"."id") and exists (
        select 1 from "plan_lines" pl
        where pl.plan_id = "orders"."approved_plan_id"
          and pl.supplier_company_id = (select public.current_company_id())
      )
orders_update_supplier_delivery.withCheck:
"orders"."state" in ('shipped', 'delivered') and public.supplier_can_access_order("orders"."id") and exists (
        select 1 from "plan_lines" pl
        where pl.plan_id = "orders"."approved_plan_id"
          and pl.supplier_company_id = (select public.current_company_id())
      )
